answers.ask: Is the lobby attached to the stadium as one map, or a separate place players teleport out of when the match starts?
answers.answer: Make the lobby attached to the modern 2026 stadium as one map, so players can vote and then go straight into the stadium match.

answers.ask: How does a match end - fixed timer, first to a score, or full-length halves?
answers.answer: Use a fixed short match timer for a simple playable game; the team with the most goals when time ends wins.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D football World Cup map set in a modern 2026 stadium, built as one connected environment rather than on a baseplate. The central stadium contains a full football pitch, surrounding spectator stands, and a large 3D screen overlooking the field. Attach a lobby area to the stadium where players gather and vote for countries before entering the match, with a direct route from the lobby into the stadium.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Sports, specifically football played on a formal stadium pitch. The voting lobby supports match staging but does not make this a separate Party & Casual genre.

### Shape and preset
Use `field-bounded`, matching the Field Sport preset. The prompt’s attached lobby is retained as an adjoining stadium concourse zone; the field itself remains the authoritative bounded play surface.

### Config requirements
Use visible `spectator-bleachers` for the full ring of modern spectator stands and `barrier-perimeter` for the stadium bowl and outer containment around the pitch. Use `trigger-bounds` as both visible painted touchlines and invisible foul/reset perimeter, `startpoint-play` as the visible centre spot and team restart positions plus their invisible reset markers, and `trigger-scoring` as the visible two goal mouths with invisible goal-detection planes. These field-sport requirements are implied by football. The lobby, country-voting area, and its 3D screen are visible geometry, not extra game-mechanic components.

### Layout components
Place the regulation-proportioned rectangular football pitch centrally, with two opposing goal areas and clear painted field markings. Wrap it on all sides with steep, continuous spectator stands inside a modern 2026 stadium bowl; mount one large 3D screen high above a long side of the field, facing the stands and pitch. Attach a substantial lobby/concourse to one stadium end, outside the field boundary but within the same connected environment. The lobby is an open gathering zone with country-voting stations arranged along its walls and a wide direct concourse route into the stadium seating and field-entry side. Build the stadium on landscaped constructed ground rather than a flat baseplate. The stadium walls, stands, and exterior approaches form the boundary; no open world extends beyond them. Compose the isometric view with the lobby readable at the foreground edge, the pitch as the centrepiece, and the screen visible above the far stand.

### Render order
Use `topdown`: the pitch dimensions, opposing goals, boundary, and direct lobby-to-stadium connection must be spatially valid for football before the isometric stadium dressing is generated.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use a large scale, driven by the full pitch, enclosing stadium bowl, spectator stands, screen, and attached crowd lobby. Theme: polished contemporary 2026 World Cup stadium, bright broadcast-ready sports architecture. Use `tiered` because the raked spectator stands are real non-overhanging elevation; no further pipeline modifier is forced.
